title: 2026-10-28_Xbash_Ransomware_Incident_Response_Scenario_729
description: Investigate the Xbash ransomware incident, identify indicators of compromise, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim host in your network has been compromised by the Xbash ransomware. This malware combines ransomware, coinmining, and self-propagation capabilities, targeting both Linux and Windows systems. Your task is to investigate the incident, identify the indicators of compromise, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Please ENTER the passkey 'start' and SUBMIT the credentials to gain access.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Please ENTER the passkey 'start' and SUBMIT the credentials to gain access.

levels.title: Identify the Command-and-Control Server
levels.content:
Identify the command-and-control server IP address used by the ransomware.

**Hint:** Check network connections and logs for suspicious outbound connections.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the command-and-control server?
levels.solution: To identify the command-and-control server, check the network connections and logs for suspicious outbound connections. The IP address of the command-and-control server is 192.168.1.100.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for unusual outbound connections in network logs.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to an unusual IP address in the output of 'netstat -tuln'.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Investigate further to find the correct IP address.

levels.title: Determine the Exfiltration Port
levels.content:
Determine which network port is used for suspicious data exfiltration.

**Hint:** Investigate network traffic to identify ports associated with exfiltration activity.

**Question:** What is the network port used for data exfiltration?
levels.solution: To determine the exfiltration port, investigate network traffic to identify ports associated with exfiltration activity. The network port used for data exfiltration is 5678.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for unusual ports in network logs.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to an unusual port in the output of 'netstat -tuln'.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Investigate further to find the correct port.

levels.title: Locate the Ransom Note
levels.content:
Locate the ransom note left on the compromised system.

**Hint:** Search the victim's home directory for files with suspicious content.

**Question:** What is the full path to the ransom note?
levels.solution: To locate the ransom note, search the victim's home directory for files with suspicious content. The full path to the ransom note is /home/cyrano/RANSOM_NOTE.txt.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Search the victim's home directory for files with suspicious content.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'find /home/cyrano -name "RANSOM_NOTE.txt"' to locate the ransom note.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Investigate further to find the correct file.
